FEAT-2-S153.title: Implement Core Specialty Identification Pipeline
FEAT-2-S153.description: Implement the dual-pipeline specialty identification logic combining regex extraction and vector-based matching, including query expansion, NUCC code mapping, deduplication, and confidence scoring.

FEAT-2-S154.title: Expose Specialty Identification via FindCare Facade
FEAT-2-S154.description: Integrate specialty identification into the FindCare facade, ensuring user input is processed and mapped to NUCC codes before downstream provider search execution.

FEAT-2-S155.title: Tool Router Integration for Specialty Queries
FEAT-2-S155.description: Ensure specialty identification is correctly triggered via tool routing, including validation of inputs and proper dispatch through the tool_router for specialty-related queries.

FEAT-2-S156.title: Integration Tests for End-to-End Specialty Mapping
FEAT-2-S156.description: Create integration tests validating that user queries are correctly transformed into NUCC codes and passed through facade and provider search layers, including multi-specialty and ambiguous inputs.
FEAT-2-S156.evidence: GAP: No existing integration test coverage for specialty-to-NUCC flow; must be created under backend/tests.
